newsitem.title: JAPAN: JGBs end lower on long liquidation by dealers.
newsitem.headline: JGBs end lower on long liquidation by dealers.

text.p: *Key September 10-year JGB futures ended Tokyo lower due to long liquidation by dealers which was triggered by the dollar's rise against the dollar.
*Trade was generally quiet, as market players adopted a cautious stance ahead of next week's key BOJ tankan survey.
